title: Asymptotic behaviour of bigraded components of local cohomology modules
summary: Let $C$ be a commutative Noetherian ring containing a field $K$ of characteristic zero. Let $R=C[X_1, \ldots, X_n, Y_1, \ldots, Y_m]$ be a polynomial ring over $C$ with $\mathrm{bideg}~ c=(0,0)$ for all $c \in C$, $\mathrm{bideg}~ X_i=(1,0)$ and $\mathrm{bideg}~ Y_j=(0,1)$ for $i=1, \ldots, n$ and $j=1, \ldots, m$. Let $I$ be a bihomogeneous ideal in $R$. In this article, we study asymptotic behaviour of bigraded pieces of the local cohomology module $H^i_I(R)$.
